what_works.description: User-visible outcome in one sentence. Empty string if nothing user-visible changed.

evidence.description: Command plus key output, at most 3 lines, or a PR/commit reference. Not a narrative.

deviations.description: Where execution departed from the task brief, and why. 'none' if it did not.

discovered.description: Every newly discovered issue. Classification is mandatory.

class.description: blocker requires reproduced=true on the acceptance path; otherwise use follow-up.

reproduced.description: True only if reproduced on the acceptance path during this run.

cost.description: Turns and wall time, e.g. '12 turns / 8m'.

next_decision.description: Questions only the decision layer can answer. Empty if none.
